schema.name: ganglior.node-export
schema.doc: Single-signal CGM analyzer export. All metrics computed in-browser from the CGM file only (nothing leaves the device). null = not computed at this recording length/quality. `timeseries` per-hour/day aggregates are the cross-node currency; `fusion` carries BOTH the ECGDex-correlation results and the producer-side values GlucoDex feeds back to the bus.

recording.tierNote: 3 days · full TIR/TAR/TBR · MAGE · CONGA · GVP · dawn valid — AGP percentile bands firm up at ≥14 d

timing.reason: no host stamp column on this input, so there is no second clock to discipline the device rate against; this node looks for neither device-clock resyncs nor axis seams, so both counts are unknown rather than zero

quality.outOfRangeNote: Low / High cells, where the sensor reported a glucose outside its measuring range. They count as active time and as time below 54 / above 250 mg/dL, and they carry no value: min is null under a Low and max is null under a High, and mean, SD, CV and GMI are over the numeric readings alone. LBGI, HBGI, ADRR and the dawn rise are floors when a Low or a High sits in their window.

sessionCorrections.note: leveling aligns each wear median to the global median (between-sensor step removal); de-drift removes the within-wear linear trend (experimental). Both reference-free, off unless enabled.

quality.note: sensorActivePct = analyzable cells ÷ timeline. Warm-up suppressed; gaps interpolated+greyed; compression lows (sustained nocturnal dip with bracketing recovery — positional artifact) flagged & held out of TBR/LBGI/hypo so they do not inflate them. AGP needs ≥70%. dataQualityConfidence scales the stability-score interpretation.
quality.compressionDetector: night-hours sustained low ≥25 min, both 2-h shoulders euglycemic (>95/>92) and dip >32 mg/dL below them with fast bilateral recovery

thresholds.note: mg/dL · consensus 2019. tbrGoalPct is the goal of the STATED therapy — null when no therapy was entered; tbrGoalInForcePct is the threshold the badges graded against (1% for a stated non-insulin therapy, 4% on insulin, and the stricter 1% when no therapy was stated).

labels.gmi: GMI is a lab-A1c PROXY, NOT your A1c. estA1c (ADAG) and GMI use different formulas and will differ.

byDaypart.note: CV localised to time-of-day — where the swings live

formulas.adrr: mean over days of (LRmax+HRmax) in Kovatchev risk space

variability.note: MODD/ADRR null if <2 days. All on the full cleaned series — decimation is render-only.

patterns.ppgrNote: per meal marker: 30-min pre-meal baseline, peak rise, time-to-peak, +2 h delta, % of days returned to baseline within 3 h
patterns.note: No meal markers set — excursions are slope-detected & labelled unannotated.

profile.note: fields the user set in the profile panel; null = default/auto

assumedDefaults.source: population norm / code default — the value the analysis ran on
assumedDefaults.note: NOT a statement by this user. A null diabetesStatus here means they did tell us.

personalization.stabilityScoreFormula: clamp(0.55·TIR + 0.45·cvScore − min(28, hypoTBR·5)); cvScore=clamp(100−(CV−25)·3); hypoTBR excludes flagged compression artifacts. Read alongside dataQualityConfidence.

fusion.note: No ECGDex export present at analysis time — single-node CGM run. Cross-signal autonomic⟷glycemic fusion (IR-risk, hypo-QTc) is computed by the Integrator when an overlapping ECGDex night is also loaded; this is not missing computation.

timeseries.doc: Per-hour AGP percentiles + per-day rollups + per-cell trace. cells[] makes this continuous node SLICEABLE: a consumer (the Integrator) recomputes glycemic metrics on any sub-window (e.g. a same-night ECG/Oxy overlap) without GlucoDex ever pre-segmenting into nights. One signal, one codex — windowing lives at the fusion layer.
timeseries.cellsNote: ONE entry per cell in time order; WARMUP cells dropped. tMs = absolute floating wall-clock ms (NOT reconstructed from a string); v = mg/dL; f = clean flag (0 OK · 2 gap-interp SHORT · 3 compression-low · 4 gap-interp LONG · 5 Low, below the sensor range · 6 High, above it). A consumer computing glucose statistics MUST exclude 3 and 4: flag 4 is a long gap (sensor change / dropout) where the value is straight-line interpolation the sensor never saw, and counting it inflates TIR/CV and any coverage figure derived from the cell count. Flags 5 and 6 carry v null: the time is measured and the value is not. Native cadence — no downsampling.

reserved.doc: Fields awaiting other fleet nodes; null until available.
